choices.topic: Fit flat curves with no plateau (CSE 1:3 ACh)?
choices.opus: Refitted the two runaway curves with slope fixed at 1: Emax 16%, EC50 599 nM.
choices.sonnet: Capped Emax at 100%; one curve still ran to the cap: Emax 36%, EC50 3003 nM.
choices.authors: 4-parameter fit for 4 of 5 experiments; experiment 2 used an unstated limit or starting value.
choices.matters: Both models: 5 CSE 1:3 acetylcholine cells. Opus graded B to D, Sonnet worse.

choices.topic: Fix Emax when a fitted curve tops 100%?
choices.opus: Refitted those curves with the slope fixed at 1, which shifted their EC50 and Emax.
choices.sonnet: Capped Emax at 100% during the fit, close to what the authors did.
choices.authors: Kept the free fit and reported Emax as 100%.
choices.matters: Opus: 4 DEA/NO cells (EC50, SEM, limits for two heated tobacco rows). Sonnet: none.

choices.topic: Which test gives the significance stars?
choices.opus: ANOVA then Dunnett vs each series' control, on Emax and log EC50; stars on Emax and EC50 cells.
choices.sonnet: ANOVA/Dunnett on per-experiment Emax only; EC50 not tested, stars on Emax only.
choices.authors: Not known beyond the caption (ANOVA with Dunnett vs control); Dunnett on their Emax rows gives the published stars.
choices.matters: Sonnet missed 2 stars (CSE 1:3, CSE 1:20) as its runaway fit widened spread. Opus matched all 24.

choices.topic: Hill curve with baseline fixed at zero or free?
choices.opus: 3-parameter Hill curve, baseline fixed at 0% relaxation; rejected free baseline.
choices.sonnet: 3-parameter Hill curve, baseline fixed at 0%, slope free; rejected free baseline.
choices.authors: 4-parameter Hill curve per experiment: free baseline, top, EC50 and slope; EC50 kept to 2 significant figures.
choices.matters: Both models: 38 cells each (most Emax, EC50, SEM and limit cells).

choices.opus: No: averaged unrounded fits from the zero-baseline model.
choices.sonnet: No: averaged unrounded fits from the zero-baseline model.
choices.authors: Averaged EC50s rounded to 2 significant figures per experiment, so edge cases flip.
choices.matters: Both models: 6 cells on a rounding edge.

choices.topic: Fit deposited worksheet curves as they are?
choices.opus: Fitted the deposited curves as given: heated tobacco undiluted DEA/NO EC50 56.6 nM.
choices.authors: Averaged values in which two experiments carry wrong worksheet entries, giving EC50 87 nM.
choices.matters: Both models: 4 cells in the heated tobacco undiluted DEA/NO row.

choices.topic: Fit each experiment or the mean curve?
choices.opus: Each experiment fitted separately; mean, SEM and CI taken over the 5 fitted values.
choices.sonnet: Each experiment fitted separately (5 fits per cell); rejected fitting the pooled mean curve.
choices.authors: Fitted a curve per experiment (4-parameter Hill, per experiment).

choices.topic: How are the 95% limits for EC50 calculated?
choices.opus: Geometric mean; limits from a t quantile (4 degrees of freedom) on log10 EC50.
choices.sonnet: Same: t(0.975, 4) on log10 EC50, back-transformed; rejected normal quantile.
